description: Parking Meters FCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Fingal County Council. This is a mapping and listing of the Locations of Parking Meters in Fingal County Council, in the Pay and Display Parking System which may include housing estates and car parks and on street parking. Coverage: Fingal County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Fingal County Council. Its tags are FCC, Fingal County Council, Open Data, Parking, Pay and Display. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
